title: REQ · FileStore.FrozenIDs reads snapshot.yaml and validates ids
summary: FrozenIDs returns frozen ids, ErrNotFound when absent, rejects unsafe ids
description: FileStore gains FrozenIDs(ctx, worldID, roundID) ([]string, error) reading worlds/<world>/rounds/<lower round>/snapshot.yaml and returning each contribution entry id in file order. A missing file maps to ErrNotFound; unsafe ids are rejected before any filesystem access.
acceptance_criteria: Given snapshot.yaml with contributions ids a and b, when FrozenIDs is called, then it returns [a b]
Given no snapshot.yaml, when FrozenIDs is called, then errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) is true
Given worldID '../x' or roundID 'a/b', when FrozenIDs is called, then an error is returned
technical_constraints: Decode with a local struct holding contributions[].id to avoid importing round
